title: Star Mosque

terrainReference.basis: Ground sample in the east forecourt just outside the mapped entrance edge.

mapIdentity.scope: The Open Cities Dhaka Survey polygon fixes the principal structure. Separate native controls fix the fountain’s location and envelope in the east forecourt.

note: Original relief anchors the eastern forecourt. The surviving prayer hall and extension retain the five-dome sequence recorded by the project architect. Heights and hidden roof details are visually bounded estimates.
